newsitem.title: USA: Dow up sharply with bonds in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow up sharply with bonds in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street rallied sharply at the open Tuesday, taking a lead from bonds, which surged after the release of a slightly lower-than-forecast fourth quarter Employment Cost Index.
The Dow was up 65 points, or 0.98 percent, at 6725 after having triggered the New York Stock Exchange's automatic curbs on index-arbitrage trades.
